test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. E lives on the floor immediately below F's floor. D lives on the 2ⁿd floor. C lives on the floor immediately below A's floor. F does not live on the 5th floor. On which floor does B live?
solution:
**Given:** 

A, B, C, D, E and F live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6.

1. E lives on the floor immediately below F's floor. D lives on the 2nd floor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af750367cc5aefdd358c17a9e6718ea2dcbc87d555267f0433809818522eb94d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8afdabca1ac44beb1db0cca8e25e85a6b4526287591c52390aaa0bba56c35294.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/603fcfb4f603fbc1e1ce2770a0ec2e377dddcd294549e0bc53172860a16b132c.png] 

 2. C lives on the floor immediately below A's floor.

 Case 3 is eliminated, case 2 and case 1 are considered.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/130a30b4a8c7d01210024028ccfe16b9e79c16cf110664e849946940d23cf2f1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccf57a006c38d2e885d69daf8f614c7a39f6d4c06c87243f08e4103ca132acbf.png] 

 3. F does not live on the 5th floor.

 Case 1 is eliminated and case 2 will be considered.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ccf57a006c38d2e885d69daf8f614c7a39f6d4c06c87243f08e4103ca132acbf.png] 

4. On which floor does B live:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bcec8e04e74947d229dbcbad76e9d6d43ed57465127462b7bc8882a0ffdb2ad1.png] 

Thus, B lives on the **'1st Floor'**.
